pick.name: Maestro (+ Android Emulator locally)
pick.what: YAML UI/E2E tests for Android, iOS simulators and web
pick.why: Works with Expo/RN/Flutter alike, easy for Claude Code to write, runs in EAS Workflows/CI
pick.free_limits: CLI free; Maestro Cloud paid (7-day trial)
pick.windows_fit: native Windows supported: download maestro.zip, extract to C:\maestro, add bin to PATH; needs Java 17+ (no WSL needed)
pick.install: Windows: download https://github.com/mobile-dev-inc/maestro/releases/latest/download/maestro.zip, extract, add bin to PATH, then maestro --help (curl|bash is macOS/Linux/WSL only)

alts.name: Firebase Test Lab (Spark quota)
alts.free_limits: Deprecated; shuts down 2027-09-30; successor Developer Device Platform (paid, billing required)

alts.name: Play Console pre-launch reports
alts.what: Automatic device tests on uploaded builds

decision: Maestro gives portable E2E tests that survive any framework change. Use Test Lab's free quota only until its 2027-09-30 shutdown.
